steps.content: The situation is swiftly brought under control. The assassins are confirmed to be not Sinner, devoid of potent weaponry. With the Fraser delegation's aid in freeing several hostages, the attackers are now cornered, their escape routes cut off.

Yet something tells you it won't end this easily. A creeping unease settles in your chest, the familiar kind that whispers of danger before it arrives. Instinctively, you reach out to activate your shackles to sense a certain person in your mind.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, emergency—our rear is under attack.

The communication channel crackles to life. Piercing wails of agony first reach your ear. Then, the visual feed flickers on, revealing a hallway drenched in blood, a nightmarish scene of utter carnage.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The targets are the Banyan special wards and a preservation station at the Ring Research Institute.

Your limbs go cold. That's where Jasmine is. And the MBCC squad—assigned to Banyan for care and security during this major operation—they're sprawled across the ground, lying motionless in pools of their own blood.
As the victims fall one after another, you finally get a clear view of the perpetrator's frenzied face—
[Transition] Corrupted Soldier Portrait

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: That's not an Outlander assassin—it's someone from the Ring Institute! But... something's off about him!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's the deal with those blades...
It's a researcher who has been driven to madness.

steps.speaker: Security
steps.content: Eeehahahaha!!!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Damn it, he's completely lost it... Stop him!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Those blades...

The man, possessed by the deadly blades, stands with eyes wide open, pupils swallowed. His body jerks unnaturally, as if the weapon in his hands is the one controlling him, cutting down every living soul in sight. Those unaccustomed to battling Mania—much less their own colleagues—are paralyzed in shock. In an instant, the medical college becomes his slaughterhouse.

At last, he reaches his destination—and with a violent surge, shatters the thick glass barrier. A hand extends through the fractured pane. The dancer braces against his shoulder, then in one fluid motion, flips over him gracefully. Finally free, she escapes the cage that has served as both her prison and her sanctuary.
Jasmine takes in the scene, her delight unmistakable.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I warned you not to touch those blades... They're dangerous, cruel, thirsty for blood... They are DisCity's weapon, your weapon...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ${PlayerName} will be sad if this goes on... So let me finish it for him.
steps.female_content: ${PlayerName} will be sad if this goes on... So let me finish it for her.

steps.content: With a bright smile, she strides toward the blade-possessed madman, snatching a torn strip of bedsheet along the way. Her movements are fluid, dodging his savage strikes with feline grace, weaving around him like a serpent circling an enraged bear.

In just a few swift moves, she leaps onto the monster's shoulders, locking her legs around his throat from behind. With a sharp twist, she wrenches his arms in the opposite direction, effortlessly pinning her bear-like opponent in an unbreakable hold.
The blades lose their hold on their puppet, shuddering violently as they unleash a terrifying wave of contamination.

steps.speaker: Security
steps.content: You... It's you...

steps.speaker: Security
steps.content: I'll kill you!!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Shut up! Do as I say!

With brutal efficiency, she wrenches the poor researcher's arms from his body, cutting short his agonized scream. Jasmine lets out a laugh as she pries the blades from the severed hands—their stiff fingers still clinging desperately to the hilts. Tossing the lifeless limbs aside, she now reclaims her "weapon."
The frenzied twin blades roar, then howl—struggling, trembling—until at last, like a guttering flame, they fall silent in her hands.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Haha... That's better! You're nothing but a pair of blades. Who you kill and where you strike—it all happens on my command!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Now...
[Scene Change] The Great Expo

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...The rescue team just recovered this footage. It occurred simultaneously with the closing ceremony attack, approximately two hours ago.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: That's enough time for her to come here.

The shackles have already sensed her presence. Your gaze snaps to the edge of the panicking crowd—and there, amid the chaos of the battlefield, stands Jasmine. Artillery fire paints the sky in bursts of light, but she only watches, her face alight with childlike wonder.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: The fireworks... so pretty...

Yet the blades in her hands thrum with a savage, murderous energy. Now that the weapon is back in her grasp, you feel for the first time the maniacal power emanating from this seemingly fragile dancer.
Even from a distance, she finds you instantly, her smile bright against the smoky veil of gunpowder, lit by fractured rays of sun.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Chief, I came to the closing ceremony after all. Don't be afraid, I'm not angry at you. You lied to me, left me behind... But I understand. You just wanted to keep me safe.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I'm sorry... but I was always going to come. My celebration... it's lasted for so many years. It has to end here.
